decision_conditions: <p>The proposed two storey side extension together with the existing hip to gable roof extension and rear dormer, by reason of their excessive combined width, bulk, massing, lack of set back on the first floor, and the side extension's failure to incorporate a sympathetic roof form would form an incongruous, discordant, contrived, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host dwelling and street scene. The proposal would thereby be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 A., DM1 B. (a), (b) and (c) of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010)</p>

<p>The proposed first floor side extension, by reason of its rearward projection of the neighbouring dwellinghouse at No. 20 South Close would result in the loss of outlook and sense of enclosure to the nearest first floor rear window serving a habitable room of this neighbouring dwelling, to the detriment of the residential amenities of the occupiers of No. 20 South Close. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy D3 D(7) of The London Plan (2021), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010)</p>
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch; first floor side extension; conversion of garage to habitable room; external alterations
